      "source": [
        "# Sales & Demand Forecasting for Businesses\n",
        "**Future Interns · Machine Learning Track · Task 1 (`FUTURE_ML_01`)**\n",
        "\n",
        "## Business scenario\n",
        "*BrightMart* is a mid-sized retail store. The store manager has three recurring questions:\n",
        "\n",
        "1. **How much will we sell over the next quarter?** (cash flow and budgeting)\n",
        "2. **Which days and weeks will be busy?** (staffing)\n",
        "3. **How much stock should we order, and how big a safety buffer do we need?** (inventory)\n",
        "\n",
        "This notebook builds a forecasting model that answers those questions with a 90-day sales forecast, an honest\n",
        "error estimate, and charts a non-technical manager can read.\n",
        "\n",
        "## Workflow\n",
        "1. Load and **audit** the data\n",
        "2. **Clean** it (duplicates, missing days, missing values, outliers)\n",
        "3. **Explore** trend and seasonality\n",
        "4. **Engineer time-based features** (trend, weekday, yearly seasonality, holidays, promotions)\n",
        "5. Train and compare models with a **rolling-origin backtest** (no peeking at the future)\n",
        "6. **Error analysis** - where does the model go wrong?\n",
        "7. **Forecast the next 90 days** with an uncertainty range\n",
        "8. Translate the forecast into **business actions**"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "aG_QixM38oOG"
      },
      "execution_count": 43,
      "source": [
        "import warnings\n",
        "from pathlib import Path\n",
        "\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import matplotlib.dates as mdates\n",
        "from sklearn.linear_model import Ridge\n",
        "from sklearn.ensemble import HistGradientBoostingRegressor\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error, mean_squared_error\n",
        "\n",
        "warnings.filterwarnings(\"ignore\")\n",
        "pd.set_option(\"display.float_format\", lambda v: f\"{v:,.2f}\")\n",
        "pd.set_option(\"display.width\", 200)\n",
        "pd.set_option(\"display.max_columns\", 20)\n",
        "plt.rcParams.update({\n",
        "    \"figure.dpi\": 110, \"font.size\": 10,\n",
        "    \"axes.spines.top\": False, \"axes.spines.right\": False,\n",
        "    \"axes.grid\": True, \"grid.alpha\": 0.25,\n",
        "})\n",
        "\n",
        "# ---- Configuration -------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "SEED = 42\n",
        "HORIZON = 90          # how many days ahead we forecast\n",
        "N_FOLDS = 4           # rolling backtest windows, each HORIZON days long\n",
        "DATA_PATH = None      # None = built-in simulated retail data; or a CSV path, e.g. \"train.csv\"\n",
        "DATE_COL = None       # CSV date column  (None = auto-detect)\n",
        "SALES_COL = None      # CSV sales column (None = auto-detect)\n",
        "\n",
        "IMG_DIR = Path(\"images\");  IMG_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)\n",
        "OUT_DIR = Path(\"outputs\"); OUT_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)\n",
        "C = {\"actual\": \"#1f2937\", \"forecast\": \"#2563eb\", \"baseline\": \"#9ca3af\",\n",
        "     \"band\": \"#bfdbfe\", \"warn\": \"#dc2626\", \"good\": \"#16a34a\"}"
      ],
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "xTjrbWL08oOI"
      },
      "source": [
        "## 1. Data\n",
        "The task allows any sales dataset, including simulated business data that represents a real sales scenario.\n",
        "This notebook ships with a **simulated four-year daily sales history for one retail store (2022-2025)** so it runs\n",
        "anywhere with no downloads. The data has the patterns real retail data has:\n",
        "\n",
        "- steady growth, a strong weekend lift and a yearly seasonal cycle\n",
        "- Black Friday, Christmas and New Year effects\n",
        "- planned promotion weeks\n",
        "- and **deliberately messy records** (duplicates, missing days, blank values, data-entry errors) so the cleaning step has real work to do\n",
        "\n",
        "To use a real dataset (Kaggle *Store Sales*, *Superstore*, ...), set `DATA_PATH` in the configuration cell. Every\n",
        "later step works unchanged."
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 317
        },
        "id": "oVeME9qE8oOI",
        "outputId": "e66af5c5-c9fc-426d-f887-198db7dfca26"
      },
      "execution_count": 44,
      "source": [
        "def black_friday(year):\n",
        "    \"\"\"The day after US Thanksgiving (4th Thursday of November).\"\"\"\n",
        "    nov1 = pd.Timestamp(year, 11, 1)\n",
        "    first_thursday = nov1 + pd.Timedelta(days=(3 - nov1.weekday()) % 7)\n",
        "    return first_thursday + pd.Timedelta(days=22)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def calendar_flags(dates):\n",
        "    \"\"\"Holiday / event flags. They are known in advance, so they can be used for future dates.\"\"\"\n",
        "    dates = pd.DatetimeIndex(dates)\n",
        "    flags = pd.DataFrame(index=dates)\n",
        "    bf = pd.DatetimeIndex([black_friday(y) for y in dates.year])\n",
        "    d = np.asarray((dates - bf).days)\n",
        "    month, day = np.asarray(dates.month), np.asarray(dates.day)\n",
        "    flags[\"black_friday\"] = (d == 0).astype(int)\n",
        "    flags[\"cyber_weekend\"] = ((d >= 1) & (d <= 3)).astype(int)\n",
        "    flags[\"xmas_run\"] = ((month == 12) & (day >= 18) & (day <= 24)).astype(int)\n",
        "    flags[\"christmas_day\"] = ((month == 12) & (day == 25)).astype(int)\n",
        "    flags[\"post_xmas\"] = ((month == 12) & (day >= 26)).astype(int)\n",
        "    flags[\"new_year_day\"] = ((month == 1) & (day == 1)).astype(int)\n",
        "    return flags\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "HOLIDAY_LIFT = {\"black_friday\": 2.3, \"cyber_weekend\": 1.5, \"xmas_run\": 1.35,\n",
        "                \"christmas_day\": 0.25, \"post_xmas\": 1.2, \"new_year_day\": 0.6}\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def make_demo_data(seed=SEED):\n",
        "    \"\"\"Simulated daily sales for one store, then deliberately 'dirtied' like a real export.\"\"\"\n",
        "    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n",
        "    dates = pd.date_range(\"2022-01-01\", \"2025-12-31\", freq=\"D\")\n",
        "    n = len(dates)\n",
        "    t = np.arange(n)\n",
        "    doy = np.asarray(dates.dayofyear, dtype=float)\n",
        "\n",
        "    trend = 1500 + 0.75 * t                                              # steady growth\n",
        "    weekday = np.array([0.82, 0.86, 0.90, 0.96, 1.12, 1.38, 1.22])[np.asarray(dates.dayofweek)]\n",
        "    yearly = 1 + 0.12 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * (doy - 100) / 365.25) + 0.10 * np.isin(np.asarray(dates.month), [11, 12])\n",
        "    flags = calendar_flags(dates)\n",
        "    holiday = np.ones(n)\n",
        "    for name, lift in HOLIDAY_LIFT.items():\n",
        "        holiday = np.where(flags[name].values == 1, lift, holiday)\n",
        "    promo_week = rng.random(n // 7 + 1) < 0.12                           # ~12% of weeks run a promotion\n",
        "    promo = promo_week[t // 7].astype(int)\n",
        "    noise = rng.lognormal(0, 0.07, n)\n",
        "\n",
        "    sales = trend * weekday * yearly * holiday * (1 + 0.22 * promo) * noise\n",
        "    raw = pd.DataFrame({\"Date\": dates, \"Sales\": sales.round(2), \"Promo\": promo})\n",
        "\n",
        "    # ---- make it messy, like a real export ----\n",
        "    ordinary = np.flatnonzero(holiday == 1)\n",
        "    picks = rng.choice(ordinary, 13, replace=False)\n",
        "    raw.loc[picks[:10], \"Sales\"] = np.nan                                # blank values\n",
        "    raw.loc[picks[10:], \"Sales\"] = raw.loc[picks[10:], \"Sales\"] * 6      # data-entry errors (x6)\n",
        "    drop_days = pd.to_datetime([\"2023-03-14\", \"2023-07-05\", \"2024-02-20\",\n",
        "                                \"2024-06-11\", \"2025-04-22\", \"2025-09-09\"])\n",
        "    raw = raw[~raw[\"Date\"].isin(drop_days)]                              # days missing entirely\n",
        "    raw = pd.concat([raw, raw.sample(5, random_state=seed)], ignore_index=True)   # duplicated rows\n",
        "    return raw\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def load_data(path=None):\n",
        "    if path is None:\n",
        "        return make_demo_data()\n",
        "    df = pd.read_csv(path, encoding=\"latin-1\")\n",
        "    date_col = DATE_COL or next(c for c in df.columns if c.lower().replace(\" \", \"\") in\n",
        "                                (\"date\", \"orderdate\", \"invoicedate\", \"ds\"))\n",
        "    sales_col = SALES_COL or next(c for c in df.columns if c.lower() in (\"sales\", \"revenue\", \"amount\", \"y\"))\n",
        "    daily = df.groupby(pd.to_datetime(df[date_col]).dt.normalize())[sales_col].sum()\n",
        "    daily = daily.reindex(pd.date_range(daily.index.min(), daily.index.max(), freq=\"D\")).fillna(0)\n",
        "    out = daily.rename_axis(\"Date\").reset_index()\n",
        "    out.columns = [\"Date\", \"Sales\"]\n",
        "    out[\"Promo\"] = 0\n",
        "    return out\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "raw = load_data(DATA_PATH)\n",
        "print(f\"Raw table: {raw.shape[0]:,} rows x {raw.shape[1]} columns\")\n",
        "raw.head(8)"
      ],
      "outputs": [

      "source": [
        "## 2. Data cleaning\n",
        "Forecasting models are very sensitive to bad history, so each problem is found, counted and fixed explicitly."
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 192
        },
        "id": "TXOEvjuM8oOK",
        "outputId": "a1f094eb-c4ac-46be-d0e0-e4409e4974d0"
      },
      "execution_count": 45,
      "source": [
        "df = raw.copy()\n",
        "df[\"Date\"] = pd.to_datetime(df[\"Date\"])\n",
        "\n",
        "# 1) duplicated rows\n",
        "n_dups = int(df.duplicated().sum())\n",
        "df = df.drop_duplicates().sort_values(\"Date\").set_index(\"Date\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# 2) calendar gaps: make sure every day exists\n",
        "full_range = pd.date_range(df.index.min(), df.index.max(), freq=\"D\")\n",
        "n_missing_days = len(full_range) - len(df)\n",
        "df = df.reindex(full_range).rename_axis(\"Date\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# 3) blank sales values (includes the gap days just created)\n",
        "n_blank = int(df[\"Sales\"].isna().sum())\n",
        "\n",
        "# 4) outliers: a day far above/below the local (15-day) median is almost certainly a data-entry error\n",
        "local_median = df[\"Sales\"].rolling(15, center=True, min_periods=5).median()\n",
        "ratio = df[\"Sales\"] / local_median.where(local_median > 0)\n",
        "is_outlier = (ratio > 4) | ((ratio < 0.1) & (df[\"Sales\"] > 0))   # a genuine zero-sales day is kept\n",
        "n_outliers = int(is_outlier.sum())\n",
        "df.loc[is_outlier, \"Sales\"] = np.nan\n",
        "\n",
        "# 5) fill gaps by linear interpolation, promo flag defaults to \"no promo\"\n",
        "df[\"Sales\"] = df[\"Sales\"].interpolate(limit_direction=\"both\")\n",
        "df[\"Promo\"] = df[\"Promo\"].fillna(0).astype(int)\n",
        "\n",
        "audit = pd.DataFrame({\n",
        "    \"Issue found\": [\"Duplicate rows\", \"Days missing from the calendar\", \"Blank sales values (incl. missing days)\", \"Outliers (data-entry errors)\"],\n",
        "    \"Count\": [n_dups, n_missing_days, n_blank, n_outliers],\n",
        "    \"Fix applied\": [\"Dropped\", \"Re-inserted as empty days\", \"Linear interpolation\", \"Removed, then interpolated\"],\n",
        "})\n",
        "print(f\"Clean series: {df.index.min():%d %b %Y} -> {df.index.max():%d %b %Y}  ({len(df):,} days, no gaps, {int(df['Sales'].isna().sum())} nulls)\")\n",
        "audit"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Clean series: 01 Jan 2022 -> 31 Dec 2025  (1,461 days, no gaps, 0 nulls)\n"
          ]
        },
        {
          "output_type": "execute_result",
          "data": {
            "text/plain": [
              "                               Issue found  Count                 Fix applied\n",
              "0                           Duplicate rows      5                     Dropped\n",
              "1           Days missing from the calendar      6   Re-inserted as empty days\n",
              "2  Blank sales values (incl. missing days)     16        Linear interpolation\n",
              "3             Outliers (data-entry errors)      3  Removed, then interpolated"
            ],

    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "behw-NU28oOL"
      },
      "source": [
        "## 3. Exploratory analysis: trend and seasonality\n",
        "Before modelling, understand what the business looks like. These patterns decide which features the model needs."
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 298
        },
        "id": "FHLaX6nn8oOL",
        "outputId": "bc4127ef-56be-4218-d367-e4f2c92dec21"
      },
      "execution_count": 46,
      "source": [
        "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 4))\n",
        "ax.plot(df.index, df[\"Sales\"], color=C[\"baseline\"], lw=0.7, alpha=0.8, label=\"Daily sales\")\n",
        "ax.plot(df.index, df[\"Sales\"].rolling(30, center=True).mean(), color=C[\"forecast\"], lw=2, label=\"30-day average\")\n",
        "for y in sorted(df.index.year.unique()):\n",
        "    bf = black_friday(y)\n",
        "    if bf in df.index:\n",
        "        ax.annotate(\"Black Friday\", (bf, df.loc[bf, \"Sales\"]), xytext=(0, 14), textcoords=\"offset points\",\n",
        "                    ha=\"center\", fontsize=7, color=C[\"warn\"], arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle=\"-\", color=C[\"warn\"], lw=0.6))\n",
        "ax.set_title(\"Daily sales history: steady growth with a strong yearly rhythm\", loc=\"left\", fontweight=\"bold\")\n",
        "ax.set_ylabel(\"Sales ($)\"); ax.legend(frameon=False, loc=\"upper left\")\n",
        "ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter(\"%b %Y\"))\n",
        "plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(IMG_DIR / \"01_sales_history.png\", bbox_inches=\"tight\"); plt.show()"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "display_data",
          "data": {
            "text/plain": [
              "<Figure size 1210x440 with 1 Axes>"
            ],
            "image/png": "\n"
          },
          "metadata": {}
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 296
        },
        "id": "Jz6_JdpB8oOM",
        "outputId": "b1dba900-3ead-476a-d84b-8bd46ebeddf8"
      },
      "execution_count": 47,
      "source": [
        "d = df.copy()\n",
        "d[\"dow\"], d[\"month\"], d[\"year\"] = d.index.dayofweek, d.index.month, d.index.year\n",
        "\n",
        "# Seasonal indices (1.00 = average). Month index compares each month to its own year's average, which removes growth.\n",
        "dow_index = d.groupby(\"dow\")[\"Sales\"].mean() / d[\"Sales\"].mean()\n",
        "d[\"rel_to_year\"] = d[\"Sales\"] / d.groupby(\"year\")[\"Sales\"].transform(\"mean\")\n",
        "month_index = d.groupby(\"month\")[\"rel_to_year\"].mean()\n",
        "annual = d.groupby(\"year\")[\"Sales\"].sum()\n",
        "\n",
        "fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(12, 3.8))\n",
        "names = [\"Mon\", \"Tue\", \"Wed\", \"Thu\", \"Fri\", \"Sat\", \"Sun\"]\n",
        "axes[0].bar(names, dow_index.values, color=[C[\"forecast\"] if v > 1 else C[\"baseline\"] for v in dow_index.values])\n",
        "axes[0].axhline(1, color=\"k\", lw=0.8); axes[0].set_title(\"Day-of-week index\", loc=\"left\", fontweight=\"bold\")\n",
        "axes[1].bar(range(12), month_index.values, color=[C[\"forecast\"] if v > 1 else C[\"baseline\"] for v in month_index.values])\n",
        "axes[1].set_xticks(range(12)); axes[1].set_xticklabels([\"J\", \"F\", \"M\", \"A\", \"M\", \"J\", \"J\", \"A\", \"S\", \"O\", \"N\", \"D\"])\n",
        "axes[1].axhline(1, color=\"k\", lw=0.8); axes[1].set_title(\"Monthly index (growth removed)\", loc=\"left\", fontweight=\"bold\")\n",
        "axes[2].bar(annual.index.astype(str), annual.values / 1e6, color=C[\"forecast\"])\n",
        "for x, v in zip(annual.index.astype(str), annual.values / 1e6):\n",
        "    axes[2].text(x, v, f\"${v:.2f}M\", ha=\"center\", va=\"bottom\", fontsize=8)\n",
        "axes[2].set_title(\"Annual sales ($M)\", loc=\"left\", fontweight=\"bold\")\n",
        "for a in axes[:2]: a.set_ylim(0.6, None)\n",
        "plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(IMG_DIR / \"02_seasonality.png\", bbox_inches=\"tight\"); plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "growth = annual.pct_change().dropna() * 100\n",
        "print(\"Year-over-year growth:\", \", \".join(f\"{y}: {g:+.1f}%\" for y, g in growth.items()))\n",
        "print(f\"Busiest weekday: {names[int(dow_index.idxmax())]} ({dow_index.max():.2f}x average) | quietest: {names[int(dow_index.idxmin())]} ({dow_index.min():.2f}x)\")"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "display_data",
          "data": {
            "text/plain": [
              "<Figure size 1320x418 with 3 Axes>"
            ],
            "image/png": "\n"
          },
          "metadata": {}
        },
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Year-over-year growth: 2023: +17.7%, 2024: +15.4%, 2025: +10.5%\n",
            "Busiest weekday: Sat (1.32x average) | quietest: Mon (0.80x)\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "lWS0EU748oOM"
      },
      "source": [
        "## 4. Time-based feature engineering\n",
        "A date by itself means nothing to a regression model, so it is converted into signals the model can learn from:\n",
        "\n",
        "| Feature group | What it captures |\n",
        "|---|---|\n",
        "| `trend` | long-run growth (years since the start of the data) |\n",
        "| `dow_*` | weekday pattern (weekends sell more) |\n",
        "| `sin/cos` pairs (Fourier terms) | smooth yearly seasonality without needing 12 separate month flags |\n",
        "| holiday flags | Black Friday, cyber weekend, Christmas run-up, Christmas Day, New Year |\n",
        "| `promo` | whether a planned promotion is running |\n",
        "\n",
        "Sales are modelled on a **log scale**. Retail effects are multiplicative (a promotion adds *+22%*, not *+$300*),\n",
        "and logs turn multiplication into addition, which linear models handle well."
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 850
        },
        "id": "Kspge6UR8oOM",
        "outputId": "dd42533a-07a4-4816-aade-d228856f3b83"
      },
      "execution_count": 48,
      "source": [
        "T0 = df.index.min()\n",
        "DOW_NAMES = [\"mon\", \"tue\", \"wed\", \"thu\", \"fri\", \"sat\", \"sun\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def build_features(dates, promo=None, n_fourier=5):\n",
        "    dates = pd.DatetimeIndex(dates)\n",
        "    X = calendar_flags(dates)\n",
        "    X[\"trend\"] = np.asarray((dates - T0).days) / 365.25\n",
        "    dow = np.asarray(dates.dayofweek)\n",
        "    for i, name in enumerate(DOW_NAMES):\n",
        "        X[f\"dow_{name}\"] = (dow == i).astype(int)\n",
        "    frac_year = np.asarray(dates.dayofyear) / 365.25\n",
        "    for k in range(1, n_fourier + 1):\n",
        "        X[f\"sin{k}\"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * k * frac_year)\n",
        "        X[f\"cos{k}\"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * k * frac_year)\n",
        "    X[\"promo\"] = 0 if promo is None else np.asarray(promo)\n",
        "    return X\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "features_preview = build_features(df.index, df[\"Promo\"])\n",
        "print(f\"{features_preview.shape[1]} features built for {len(features_preview):,} days\")\n",
        "bf_days = [black_friday(y) for y in df.index.year.unique() if black_friday(y) in df.index]\n",
        "preview_days = [df.index[0], df.index[len(df) // 2]] + bf_days[-1:]\n",
        "features_preview.loc[preview_days].T"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "25 features built for 1,461 days\n"
          ]
        },

      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "7VVnKtKt8oON"
      },
      "source": [
        "## 5. Models and a fair backtest\n",
        "Five forecasters are compared, from simple to more capable:\n",
        "\n",
        "| Model | Idea |\n",
        "|---|---|\n",
        "| **Seasonal naive** | \"Same weekday, one year (364 days) ago\" - the benchmark any real model must beat |\n",
        "| **Recent weekday average** | average of the last 4 occurrences of each weekday |\n",
        "| **Ridge regression** | linear model on the engineered features (log scale) |\n",
        "| **Gradient boosting** | tree ensemble on the same features; captures interactions |\n",
        "| **Hybrid: Ridge + boosting** | Ridge captures trend and seasonality, boosting learns what Ridge misses (e.g. holiday x weekend) |\n",
        "\n",
        "**Backtest design.** Random train/test splits leak the future into the past, so they are wrong for time series.\n",
        "Instead the model is trained on history up to a cut-off date and asked to forecast the next 90 days, which is\n",
        "exactly the real use case, and this is repeated across four consecutive windows covering the most recent year.\n",
        "The planned promo calendar is treated as known in advance, which is realistic for a business."
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 274
        },
        "id": "tx146wYc8oON",
        "outputId": "456434a2-f0ef-4a15-9bc9-8fd3077743c7"
      },
      "execution_count": 49,
      "source": [
        "def seasonal_naive(train, future_dates, future_promo, lag=364):\n",
        "    s = train[\"Sales\"]\n",
        "    out = []\n",
        "    for d_ in future_dates:\n",
        "        src = d_ - pd.Timedelta(days=lag)\n",
        "        while src > s.index[-1]:\n",
        "            src -= pd.Timedelta(days=lag)\n",
        "        out.append(s.loc[src])\n",
        "    return np.asarray(out)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def weekday_average(train, future_dates, future_promo, weeks=4):\n",
        "    recent = train[\"Sales\"].iloc[-7 * weeks:]\n",
        "    by_dow = recent.groupby(recent.index.dayofweek).mean()\n",
        "    return np.asarray([by_dow[d_.dayofweek] for d_ in future_dates])\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def _ridge(train):\n",
        "    Xtr = build_features(train.index, train[\"Promo\"])\n",
        "    mu, sd = Xtr.mean(), Xtr.std().replace(0, 1)\n",
        "    model = Ridge(alpha=1.0).fit((Xtr - mu) / sd, np.log1p(train[\"Sales\"]))\n",
        "    return model, mu, sd, Xtr\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def ridge_model(train, future_dates, future_promo):\n",
        "    model, mu, sd, _ = _ridge(train)\n",
        "    Xf = build_features(future_dates, future_promo)\n",
        "    return np.expm1(model.predict((Xf - mu) / sd))\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def _gbm():\n",
        "    return HistGradientBoostingRegressor(max_iter=300, learning_rate=0.05, max_leaf_nodes=12,\n",
        "                                         min_samples_leaf=20, l2_regularization=1.0, random_state=SEED)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def gbm_model(train, future_dates, future_promo):\n",
        "    Xtr = build_features(train.index, train[\"Promo\"])\n",
        "    model = _gbm().fit(Xtr, np.log1p(train[\"Sales\"]))\n",
        "    return np.expm1(model.predict(build_features(future_dates, future_promo)))\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def hybrid_model(train, future_dates, future_promo):\n",
        "    ridge, mu, sd, Xtr = _ridge(train)\n",
        "    resid = np.log1p(train[\"Sales\"]) - ridge.predict((Xtr - mu) / sd)\n",
        "    booster = _gbm().fit(Xtr, resid)\n",
        "    Xf = build_features(future_dates, future_promo)\n",
        "    return np.expm1(ridge.predict((Xf - mu) / sd) + booster.predict(Xf))\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "MODELS = {\n",
        "    \"Seasonal naive (same day last year)\": seasonal_naive,\n",
        "    \"Recent weekday average\": weekday_average,\n",
        "    \"Ridge regression\": ridge_model,\n",
        "    \"Gradient boosting\": gbm_model,\n",
        "    \"Hybrid: Ridge + boosting\": hybrid_model,\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def score(y, p):\n",
        "    y = np.asarray(y, dtype=float)\n",
        "    err = np.asarray(p) - y\n",
        "    return {\"MAE ($)\": np.abs(err).mean(),\n",
        "            \"RMSE ($)\": np.sqrt((err ** 2).mean()),\n",
        "            \"MAPE (%)\": (np.abs(err)[y > 0] / y[y > 0]).mean() * 100,\n",
        "            \"WAPE (%)\": np.abs(err).sum() / np.sum(y) * 100,\n",
        "            \"Bias (%)\": err.sum() / np.sum(y) * 100}\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "rows, oos = [], []\n",
        "for k in range(N_FOLDS):\n",
        "    stop = len(df) - k * HORIZON\n",
        "    test, train = df.iloc[stop - HORIZON:stop], df.iloc[:stop - HORIZON]\n",
        "    for name, fn in MODELS.items():\n",
        "        pred = fn(train, test.index, test[\"Promo\"].values)\n",
        "        rows.append({\"Model\": name, \"Fold\": k + 1, **score(test[\"Sales\"].values, pred)})\n",
        "        oos.append(pd.DataFrame({\"Model\": name, \"Fold\": k + 1, \"Actual\": test[\"Sales\"].values, \"Pred\": pred}, index=test.index))\n",
        "\n",
        "folds = pd.DataFrame(rows)\n",
        "oos = pd.concat(oos)\n",
        "leaderboard = folds.groupby(\"Model\")[[\"MAE ($)\", \"RMSE ($)\", \"MAPE (%)\", \"WAPE (%)\", \"Bias (%)\"]].mean().sort_values(\"WAPE (%)\")\n",
        "BEST = leaderboard.index[0]\n",
        "print(f\"Backtest: {N_FOLDS} windows x {HORIZON} days, averaged. Lower is better (WAPE = total error as % of total sales).\")\n",
        "leaderboard"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Backtest: 4 windows x 90 days, averaged. Lower is better (WAPE = total error as % of total sales).\n"
          ]

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 333
        },
        "id": "Zhdk3xJR8oON",
        "outputId": "cf0791d9-d602-4070-d817-390a82f452c1"
      },
      "execution_count": 50,
      "source": [
        "base_name = \"Seasonal naive (same day last year)\"\n",
        "improvement = (1 - leaderboard.loc[BEST, \"WAPE (%)\"] / leaderboard.loc[base_name, \"WAPE (%)\"]) * 100\n",
        "print(f\"Best model: {BEST}\")\n",
        "print(f\"Typical error: {leaderboard.loc[BEST, 'WAPE (%)']:.1f}% of sales  |  baseline: {leaderboard.loc[base_name, 'WAPE (%)']:.1f}%  ->  {improvement:.0f}% fewer errors than the baseline\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Latest 90-day window: the hardest test (it contains Black Friday and Christmas)\n",
        "latest = oos[oos[\"Fold\"] == 1]\n",
        "best_latest = latest[latest[\"Model\"] == BEST]\n",
        "base_latest = latest[latest[\"Model\"] == base_name]\n",
        "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 4))\n",
        "ax.plot(best_latest.index, best_latest[\"Actual\"], color=C[\"actual\"], lw=1.8, label=\"Actual\")\n",
        "ax.plot(base_latest.index, base_latest[\"Pred\"], color=C[\"baseline\"], lw=1.3, ls=\"--\", label=\"Baseline: same day last year\")\n",
        "ax.plot(best_latest.index, best_latest[\"Pred\"], color=C[\"forecast\"], lw=1.8, label=f\"Model: {BEST}\")\n",
        "bf = black_friday(best_latest.index[0].year)\n",
        "if bf in best_latest.index:\n",
        "    ax.annotate(\"Black Friday\", (bf, best_latest.loc[bf, \"Actual\"]), xytext=(-60, 5),\n",
        "                textcoords=\"offset points\", fontsize=8, color=C[\"warn\"], arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle=\"->\", color=C[\"warn\"]))\n",
        "ax.set_title(f\"Backtest on the last {HORIZON} days (model never saw this period)\", loc=\"left\", fontweight=\"bold\")\n",
        "ax.set_ylabel(\"Sales ($)\"); ax.legend(frameon=False, ncol=1, loc=\"upper right\")\n",
        "ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter(\"%d %b\"))\n",
        "plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(IMG_DIR / \"03_backtest_latest_window.png\", bbox_inches=\"tight\"); plt.show()"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Best model: Ridge regression\n",
            "Typical error: 6.3% of sales  |  baseline: 14.0%  ->  55% fewer errors than the baseline\n"
          ]
        },

    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "W5FCGFNo8oOO"
      },
      "source": [
        "## 6. Error analysis\n",
        "A single accuracy number hides *where* a model fails. Here the best model's out-of-sample errors across all\n",
        "four backtest windows are broken down by weekday and by event type."
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 299
        },
        "id": "5AhlS99X8oOO",
        "outputId": "c5a9f978-3b9a-45b0-b35d-4d2d542f6ef4"
      },
      "execution_count": 51,
      "source": [
        "bt = oos[oos[\"Model\"] == BEST].copy()\n",
        "bt[\"err_pct\"] = (bt[\"Pred\"] - bt[\"Actual\"]) / bt[\"Actual\"].where(bt[\"Actual\"] > 0) * 100\n",
        "bt[\"dow\"] = bt.index.dayofweek\n",
        "is_event = calendar_flags(bt.index).sum(axis=1) > 0\n",
        "bt[\"day_type\"] = np.where(is_event.values, \"Holiday / event days\", \"Ordinary days\")\n",
        "\n",
        "by_dow = bt.groupby(\"dow\").apply(lambda g: np.abs(g[\"Pred\"] - g[\"Actual\"]).sum() / g[\"Actual\"].sum() * 100)\n",
        "by_type = bt.groupby(\"day_type\").apply(lambda g: np.abs(g[\"Pred\"] - g[\"Actual\"]).sum() / g[\"Actual\"].sum() * 100)\n",
        "\n",
        "fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(12, 3.6))\n",
        "axes[0].hist(bt[\"err_pct\"], bins=30, color=C[\"forecast\"], alpha=0.85)\n",
        "axes[0].axvline(0, color=\"k\", lw=1)\n",
        "axes[0].set_title(\"Forecast error per day (%)\", loc=\"left\", fontweight=\"bold\"); axes[0].set_xlabel(\"negative = under-forecast\")\n",
        "axes[1].bar(names, by_dow.values, color=C[\"forecast\"]); axes[1].set_title(\"Error by weekday (WAPE %)\", loc=\"left\", fontweight=\"bold\")\n",
        "axes[2].scatter(bt[\"Actual\"], bt[\"Pred\"], s=10, alpha=0.5, color=C[\"forecast\"])\n",
        "lim = [bt[[\"Actual\", \"Pred\"]].min().min(), bt[[\"Actual\", \"Pred\"]].max().max()]\n",
        "axes[2].plot(lim, lim, color=\"k\", lw=1); axes[2].set_xlabel(\"Actual ($)\"); axes[2].set_ylabel(\"Predicted ($)\")\n",
        "axes[2].set_title(\"Predicted vs actual\", loc=\"left\", fontweight=\"bold\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(IMG_DIR / \"04_error_analysis.png\", bbox_inches=\"tight\"); plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Error by day type (WAPE %):\", \", \".join(f\"{k}: {v:.1f}%\" for k, v in by_type.items()))\n",
        "print(f\"Bias: the model {'over' if bt['err_pct'].mean() > 0 else 'under'}-forecasts by {abs(bt['err_pct'].mean()):.1f}% on average\")\n",
        "print(f\"90% of daily errors fall between {bt['err_pct'].quantile(0.05):+.1f}% and {bt['err_pct'].quantile(0.95):+.1f}%\")"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "display_data",
          "data": {
            "text/plain": [
              "<Figure size 1320x396 with 3 Axes>"
            ],
            "image/png": "\n"
          },
          "metadata": {}
        },
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Error by day type (WAPE %): Holiday / event days: 5.5%, Ordinary days: 6.3%\n",
            "Bias: the model over-forecasts by 2.6% on average\n",
            "90% of daily errors fall between -9.1% and +15.9%\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "AP-Du_yD8oOO"
      },
      "source": [
        "## 7. Forecast the next 90 days\n",
        "The winning model is retrained on **all** available history and projected forward. Because no future promotions\n",
        "are planned in this scenario, `promo = 0` (a what-if for running one comes later).\n",
        "\n",
        "**Uncertainty range.** A single line implies false precision. The 90% band is built from the model's *own backtest\n",
        "errors* (5th-95th percentile of actual/forecast on a log scale), so it reflects the accuracy the model really achieved on unseen data."
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 312
        },
        "id": "__TE2Iov8oOO",
        "outputId": "a5526405-caa5-437e-b906-a147e1d2a1bb"
      },
      "execution_count": 52,
      "source": [
        "future_dates = pd.date_range(df.index[-1] + pd.Timedelta(days=1), periods=HORIZON, freq=\"D\")\n",
        "no_promo = np.zeros(HORIZON, dtype=int)\n",
        "final_fn = MODELS[BEST]\n",
        "\n",
        "point = final_fn(df, future_dates, no_promo)\n",
        "log_err = np.log(bt[\"Actual\"] / bt[\"Pred\"])[bt[\"Actual\"] > 0]\n",
        "lo_mult, hi_mult = np.exp(log_err.quantile(0.05)), np.exp(log_err.quantile(0.95))\n",
        "\n",
        "forecast = pd.DataFrame({\"Forecast\": point, \"Lower_90\": point * lo_mult, \"Upper_90\": point * hi_mult}, index=future_dates)\n",
        "forecast[\"Weekday\"] = forecast.index.day_name()\n",
        "forecast.rename_axis(\"Date\").round(2).to_csv(OUT_DIR / \"forecast_next_90_days.csv\")\n",
        "leaderboard.round(3).to_csv(OUT_DIR / \"model_comparison.csv\")\n",
        "\n",
        "history = df.iloc[-120:]\n",
        "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 4.2))\n",
        "ax.plot(history.index, history[\"Sales\"], color=C[\"actual\"], lw=1.4, label=\"Actual (last 120 days)\")\n",
        "ax.fill_between(forecast.index, forecast[\"Lower_90\"], forecast[\"Upper_90\"], color=C[\"band\"], alpha=0.7, label=\"90% range\")\n",
        "ax.plot(forecast.index, forecast[\"Forecast\"], color=C[\"forecast\"], lw=2, label=\"Forecast\")\n",
        "ax.axvline(df.index[-1], color=\"k\", lw=0.8, ls=\":\")\n",
        "ax.text(df.index[-1], ax.get_ylim()[1], \"  today\", va=\"top\", fontsize=8)\n",
        "ax.set_title(f\"Daily sales forecast: next {HORIZON} days\", loc=\"left\", fontweight=\"bold\")\n",
        "ax.set_ylabel(\"Sales ($)\"); ax.legend(frameon=False, loc=\"upper left\", ncol=3)\n",
        "ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter(\"%d %b\"))\n",
        "plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(IMG_DIR / \"05_forecast_daily.png\", bbox_inches=\"tight\"); plt.show()"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "display_data",
          "data": {
            "text/plain": [
              "<Figure size 1210x462 with 1 Axes>"
            ],
            "image/png": "\n"
          },
          "metadata": {}
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 441
        },
        "id": "ybXzEQC68oOP",
        "outputId": "7246b477-7d6e-4a99-8363-c5eca596f354"
      },
      "execution_count": 53,
      "source": [
        "# Weekly view: what a manager actually plans against (full Mon-Sun weeks only)\n",
        "def full_weeks(series):\n",
        "    agg = series.resample(\"W\").agg([\"sum\", \"count\"])\n",
        "    return agg.loc[agg[\"count\"] == 7, \"sum\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "weekly_hist = full_weeks(df[\"Sales\"].iloc[-100:]).iloc[-12:]\n",
        "weekly_fc = full_weeks(forecast[\"Forecast\"])\n",
        "\n",
        "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 3.8))\n",
        "ax.bar(weekly_hist.index, weekly_hist.values / 1e3, width=5, color=C[\"baseline\"], label=\"Actual weekly sales\")\n",
        "ax.bar(weekly_fc.index, weekly_fc.values / 1e3, width=5, color=C[\"forecast\"], label=\"Forecast weekly sales\")\n",
        "ax.set_ylabel(\"Sales ($ thousands per week)\")\n",
        "ax.set_title(\"Weekly sales (full Mon-Sun weeks): recent history and forecast\", loc=\"left\", fontweight=\"bold\")\n",
        "ax.legend(frameon=False, loc=\"upper left\")\n",
        "ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter(\"%d %b\"))\n",
        "plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(IMG_DIR / \"06_forecast_weekly.png\", bbox_inches=\"tight\"); plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Monthly summary vs. the same months a year earlier\n",
        "fc_month = forecast[\"Forecast\"].groupby(forecast.index.to_period(\"M\")).sum()\n",
        "rows = []\n",
        "for per, val in fc_month.items():\n",
        "    prev = df[\"Sales\"][(df.index.year == per.year - 1) & (df.index.month == per.month)]\n",
        "    days_in_fc = int((forecast.index.to_period(\"M\") == per).sum())\n",
        "    prev = prev.iloc[:days_in_fc]\n",
        "    rows.append({\"Month\": str(per), \"Days\": days_in_fc, \"Forecast ($)\": val, \"Same days last year ($)\": prev.sum(),\n",
        "                 \"Growth vs last year (%)\": (val / prev.sum() - 1) * 100})\n",
        "monthly = pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index(\"Month\")\n",
        "monthly"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "display_data",
          "data": {

      "source": [
        "## 8. From forecast to business decisions\n",
        "The numbers below are computed directly from the model, so they update if the data or horizon changes."
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "SSwotJH88oOP",
        "outputId": "d9da4e3c-f6e4-4635-e8cf-31e993840f74"
      },
      "execution_count": 54,
      "source": [
        "total_fc = forecast[\"Forecast\"].sum()\n",
        "# How far off were whole-window (90-day) totals in the backtest? That is the honest error on a quarterly number.\n",
        "window_miss = bt.groupby(\"Fold\").apply(lambda g: g[\"Actual\"].sum() / g[\"Pred\"].sum() - 1) * 100\n",
        "conservative_total = total_fc * (1 + window_miss.min() / 100)\n",
        "prev_year = df[\"Sales\"].loc[future_dates[0] - pd.DateOffset(years=1): future_dates[-1] - pd.DateOffset(years=1)].sum()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Weekly safety buffer: how far did weekly actuals overshoot the forecast in the backtest?\n",
        "wk = bt[[\"Actual\", \"Pred\"]].resample(\"W\").agg([\"sum\", \"count\"])\n",
        "weekly_bt = wk.loc[wk[(\"Actual\", \"count\")] == 7].xs(\"sum\", axis=1, level=1)\n",
        "buffer_pct = (weekly_bt[\"Actual\"] / weekly_bt[\"Pred\"]).quantile(0.95) - 1\n",
        "\n",
        "# What-if: promotion across the whole horizon (planned promos are modelled as +x% uplift)\n",
        "promo_on = final_fn(df, future_dates, np.ones(HORIZON, dtype=int))\n",
        "promo_uplift = (promo_on.sum() / point.sum() - 1) * 100\n",
        "\n",
        "peak_day = forecast[\"Forecast\"].idxmax()\n",
        "slow_day = forecast[\"Forecast\"].idxmin()\n",
        "weekend = forecast[forecast.index.dayofweek >= 5][\"Forecast\"].sum() / total_fc * 100\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"FORECAST SUMMARY: {future_dates[0]:%d %b %Y} to {future_dates[-1]:%d %b %Y}\")\n",
        "print(\"-\" * 70)\n",
        "print(f\"Expected sales            : ${total_fc:,.0f}\")\n",
        "print(f\"Backtest 90-day total miss: {window_miss.min():+.1f}% to {window_miss.max():+.1f}% (actual vs forecast, across {N_FOLDS} windows)\")\n",
        "print(f\"Conservative budget figure: ${conservative_total:,.0f}  (forecast adjusted for the worst window miss)\")\n",
        "print(f\"vs same period last year  : {(total_fc / prev_year - 1) * 100:+.1f}%\")\n",
        "print(f\"Busiest forecast day      : {peak_day:%a %d %b}  (${forecast.loc[peak_day, 'Forecast']:,.0f})\")\n",
        "print(f\"Quietest forecast day     : {slow_day:%a %d %b}  (${forecast.loc[slow_day, 'Forecast']:,.0f})\")\n",
        "print(f\"Weekend share of sales    : {weekend:.0f}% (2 of every 7 days)\")\n",
        "print(f\"Suggested weekly buffer   : +{buffer_pct * 100:.0f}% above forecast covers 95% of backtest weeks\")\n",
        "print(f\"Promotion what-if         : a promotion running all {HORIZON} days would lift sales by about {promo_uplift:.0f}%\")"
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "FORECAST SUMMARY: 01 Jan 2026 to 31 Mar 2026\n",
            "----------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
            "Expected sales            : $228,422\n",
            "Backtest 90-day total miss: -4.2% to -0.7% (actual vs forecast, across 4 windows)\n",
            "Conservative budget figure: $218,788  (forecast adjusted for the worst window miss)\n",
            "vs same period last year  : +10.1%\n",
            "Busiest forecast day      : Sat 28 Mar  ($3,632)\n",
            "Quietest forecast day     : Thu 01 Jan  ($1,281)\n",
            "Weekend share of sales    : 36% (2 of every 7 days)\n",
            "Suggested weekly buffer   : +3% above forecast covers 95% of backtest weeks\n",
            "Promotion what-if         : a promotion running all 90 days would lift sales by about 22%\n"

    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "truF7ZVE8oOP"
      },
      "source": [
        "### What the forecast means\n",
        "The forecast is the model's best estimate of daily revenue for the next 90 days, given the store's growth trend,\n",
        "weekly rhythm, yearly seasonality, holiday effects and promotion calendar. The shaded band is the realistic range:\n",
        "about 9 days in 10 should land inside it, based on how the model performed on periods it had never seen.\n",
        "\n",
        "### How a business can use it\n",
        "| Decision | How to use the forecast |\n",
        "|---|---|\n",
        "| **Inventory** | Order to the weekly forecast and add the safety buffer printed above. Use the *upper* bound only for fast-selling, high-margin items where a stock-out is costly. |\n",
        "| **Staffing** | Roster to the weekday pattern: add shifts on Fri-Sun and the peak days flagged above, trim on the quietest days. |\n",
        "| **Cash flow** | Commit fixed costs against the *conservative budget figure* printed above, so budgets hold even in a soft quarter. |\n",
        "| **Promotions** | Use the what-if estimate to judge whether a promotion's lift covers its discount cost, and schedule it in a slow week rather than a peak week. |\n",
        "| **Monitoring** | Compare actuals with the band every week. Repeated misses outside the band mean something changed (new competitor, pricing, supply issue) and the model should be retrained. |\n",
        "\n",
        "### Limitations and next steps\n",
        "- The forecast assumes the future behaves like the past. A new competitor, a price change or a supply disruption will not be seen by the model.\n",
        "- Results here use **simulated data**; on a real dataset, re-run the notebook and re-check the leaderboard, since a different model may win.\n",
        "- Next steps: forecast per product category or store, add external drivers (weather, local events, ad spend), and retrain automatically each week."
      ]
    }
